title: The Effect of Medicaid Expansion on Wait Time in the Emergency Department
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD: hospitals in states that expanded Medicaid on Jan 1, 2014 vs states that did not expand before 2016; treat_medicaid switches on in 2014 for all 24 treated states (verified in AverageEffects.dta: first treated year 2014 for every treated state; annual 2012-2016). One adoption cohort, so not staggered. Column 1 (reg ln_score_num treat_medicaid Time* Hospital*, cl state) would otherwise satisfy the FE rule; other columns add ACS and hospital time-varying controls. Heterogeneity via first-difference causal forest (R).
design_notes: Balanced hospital-year panel, 2,236 hospitals x 5 years (11,180 rows), outcome log ED wait time (CMS Hospital Compare). Treatment group excludes later expanders by design.
ineligible_specs_listed: Table 2 cols 1-4: treat_medicaid with hospital and year dummies, cols 2-4 add time-varying controls; single adoption date (2014)
data_files_note: readme.txt: constructed from public CMS Hospital Compare and ACS data; analysis datasets shipped.
screener_notes: Excluded only because adoption is not staggered (2014 expanders vs non-expanders). Table numbering for the DiD regressions inferred from code order; no article text.
